enriched_description: Medium-sized sled dog with a thick, double coat in various colors including black-and-white, grey-and-white, red-and-white, and solid white. Coat is dense with a soft undercoat and straight outer guard hairs. Body is athletic, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is medium-sized with a moderate skull and tapered muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, triangular, erect, and set high. Tail is bushy, fox-brush shaped, and carried over the back in a sickle curve. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and blue, brown, or one of each (heterochromia) with an alert, friendly expression. The breed resembles the larger Alaskan malamute but is lighter and more agile.

Large, athletic dog with a distinctive smooth, white coat covered with black or brown (liver) spots. Coat is short, dense, fine, and sleek with spots evenly distributed over the body. Body is well-proportioned, muscular, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is long and lean with a flat skull and strong muzzle. Ears are set high, thin, and carried close to the head. Tail is long, tapering, and carried with a slight upward curve. Eyes are medium-sized, round, and brown or blue with an intelligent, alert expression. The breed's signature feature is its unique spotted coat pattern on a white background.

Small, terrier-like dog with a dark, wiry, harsh coat in black, grey, silver, red, or black-and-tan. Coat is approximately 1 inch long, rough-textured, and stands off from the body with a distinctive shaggy appearance around the head. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and sturdy. Head is round with a short muzzle and prominent chin, giving a monkey-like expression. Ears are set high, traditionally cropped to erect points, or natural and pendant. Tail is docked short and carried high. Eyes are dark, round, and prominent with a mischievous, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its wiry coat, tufted muzzle, and distinctive monkey-like face.

Small, smooth-haired African breed with a short, fine coat in red, black, tricolor, or brindle with white markings on feet, chest, and tail tip. Coat is sleek, glossy, and lies close to the body. Body is athletic, well-proportioned, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is finely wrinkled with a flat skull and tapered muzzle. Ears are small, pointed, erect, and set forward. Tail is tightly curled over the hip on one or both sides. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its tightly curled tail, wrinkled forehead, and inability to bark (produces a yodel-like sound instead).

Small, compact dog with a smooth, short coat in fawn or black. Coat is fine, glossy, and lies close to the body. Body is cobby, square-proportioned, and muscular with a broad chest. Head is large and round with a short, broad, wrinkled muzzle and flat face. Ears are small, thin, velvet-like, and folded back (button ears) or rose-shaped. Tail is tightly curled over the hip. Eyes are large, round, prominent, and dark with a soft, pleading expression. The breed's signature features include its flat, wrinkled face, large round eyes, and tightly curled tail.

Very large dog with a golden coat ranging from light cream to deep red, often with a black mask. Coat is medium to long, soft, and water-resistant with a dense undercoat. Body is massive, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad chest. Head is broad with a moderate skull and strong muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, pendant, triangular, and set high. Tail is long, bushy, and carried low with a slight upward curve. Eyes are medium-sized, oval, and dark brown with a gentle, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its large size, golden coat, and lion-like mane in males.

Very large, heavy dog with a thick, coarse, usually black coat (also brown, grey, or black-and-white). Coat is double-layered with a soft, dense undercoat and coarse, flat outer coat that is water-resistant. Body is massive, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad chest. Head is broad and massive with a short muzzle. Ears are small, triangular, pendant, and set back. Tail is long, broad, and carried low with a slight upward curve. Eyes are small, deep-set, dark brown, and wide apart with a gentle, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its massive size, webbed feet, thick coat, and reputation as a vigorous swimmer.

Large, heavy-coated white dog with a thick, double coat that is predominantly white with possible grey, badger, reddish-brown, or tan markings. Coat is long, flat, coarse, and weather-resistant with a dense, fine undercoat. Body is massive, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad chest. Head is broad with a moderate skull and strong muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, pendant, triangular, and set at eye level. Tail is long, bushy, and carried over the back in a plume. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with a gentle, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its massive size, white coat, and protective livestock guardian heritage.

Siberian spitz-type dog with a white or cream-colored, thick, double coat. Coat is dense, glossy, and stands off from the body with a pronounced ruff around the neck. Body is medium-sized, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is broad and wedge-shaped with a moderate stop and strong muzzle. Ears are thick, triangular, erect, and set wide apart. Tail is long, well-feathered, and carried curled over the back. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown or black with a friendly, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its white coat, smiling expression, and plumed tail carried over the back.

Very small, compact spitz-type dog with a long, abundant double coat in various colors including orange, red, cream, black, brown, blue, sable, or white. Coat is straight, harsh-textured, and stands off from the body with a pronounced ruff around the neck. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and well-balanced. Head is fox-like with a moderate skull and fine muzzle. Ears are small, erect, triangular, and set high. Tail is flat, well-feathered, and carried flat over the back. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its tiny size, abundant coat, and fox-like face.
